yrr6xfck.baseName: My Christmas 6ft Artificial Green Christmas Tree with 800 Tips - Green
yrr6xfck.variantName: My Christmas 6ft Artificial Green Christmas Tree with 800 Tips - Green
yrr6xfck.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this realistic green artificial Christmas tree, featuring lush PVC branches for a full, traditional appearance. Designed as a reusable alternative to a real tree, it has a sturdy metal frame and folding metal base to provide reliable support throughout the festive season. The tree comes in three hinged sections for straightforward assembly and convenient storage after use. Simply connect the sections, unfold the branches and shape them to achieve the desired fullness. Suitable for seasonal decorating, this durable tree can be styled with your favourite baubles, tinsel and Christmas lights. Mains-operated Christmas lights are available separately and can be used indoors or outdoors, provided the transformer remains indoors. Specifications: Made from PVC with a durable metal frame and folding metal base. Three hinged sections for easy assembly and storage. Christmas lights are sold separately. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

w3bx60nx.baseName: OHS 6ft 500 Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink
w3bx60nx.variantName: OHS 6ft 500 Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink
w3bx60nx.sourceDescription: Make a statement this Christmas with the OHS Artificial Christmas Tree. Standing at 6ft tall, this decorative tree features 500 tips to create a full shape, ready to be styled to suit your festive theme. Available in a range of eye-catching colourways, from classic green to contemporary pink, chocolate, burgundy and black, it offers a stylish alternative to traditional Christmas trees. Whether decorated with coordinating ornaments for a sophisticated look or colourful baubles for a playful festive display, this versatile tree makes a striking centrepiece for living rooms and seasonal celebrations. Key Benefit • 500 Tips for a Full Look • 6ft Festive Centrepiece • Perfect for Personalised Christmas Decorating Dimensions: H183 cm Material: 80% PVC, 20% Iron Care Instructions: To achieve the fullest and most natural appearance, all branches and tips of your Christmas tree will need to be individually fluffed after assembly. Trees are compressed during packaging and shipping to protect them in transit. Keep away from fire. Online Home Shop, Priestley Road, Manchester, M28 2LX

xnm3ms81.variantName: My Christmas Snow Tipped Artificial Garland with Lights 270cm
xnm3ms81.sourceDescription: This 270cm snow-tipped Christmas garland creates a festive winter display with its snowy green finish, traditional red berries and decorative pinecones. The flexible design can be shaped and arranged around fireplaces, mantels, staircases, banisters, doorways and walls, allowing you to create a variety of Christmas displays. Featuring 30 LED lights, it adds a warm festive glow to your décor, while the durable construction is designed for repeated seasonal use. Specifications: Snow-tipped artificial green finish, 30 LED lights, decorative red berries and pinecones, flexible and easy to shape, suitable for fireplaces, mantels, staircases, banisters, doorways and walls, and designed for seasonal indoor Christmas decoration. Dimensions: Length: 270 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
